children: Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited warned that scam websites impersonating its official site are luring users into providing bank account details through virtual-wallet deposits and withdrawals. According to Odaily, the sites claim to offer online transaction support for the Faster Payment System (FPS), including refunds and help reporting unauthorized transactions. The company said it generally does not provide FPS services directly to individuals or proactively contact members of the public, and urged people not to share personal or banking information with the sites.

title: Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited Warns of Fake Websites Seeking Bank Details
